scenes.text: Someone says boats die on this reef. So you swim out to see for yourself.
You're shipwrecked. Every night, someone switches off your beacon. Then they left a message in the sand. Boats die here.
First, a float. Your empty bottle, tied to a piece of driftwood.
Then you swim. All the way out to the reef.
Up close, it's razor sharp coral, just under the surface. The waves smash over it, all the way around the island.
And stuck on top of it, the old wreck you saw from the lookout.
A sailboat. Older than you. Rust everywhere.
Inside, a beacon. The same kind as yours. Dead for years.
The current drags you toward the coral. You can't swim against it.
You wake up on the beach.
Your leg is wrapped in an old piece of cloth. Someone dragged you out.
And at the edge of the jungle, a man is walking away. Limping.
He saved your life. And he still doesn't want to be found. What do you do? Top comment decides part five.
